name: Tenbin Mexican Peso
oneLiner: tMXN is Tenbin's synthetic Mexican peso token on Ethereum, backed by USDC reserves hedged with CME MXN futures under KYC-gated USDC mint and redemption.
collateral: Synthetic Mexican peso exposure, not Mexican peso bank deposits: each token represents an unsecured Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd. segregated-portfolio debt-note (a UCC Article 12 controllable electronic record) referencing the USD value of one Mexican peso at the spot price. Backed by Circle USDC held on-chain in a Steakhouse USDC Morpho V2 vault (451,180.52 USDC at Ethereum block 26505955) and off-chain at prime broker Ripple Prime and FCM accounts margining CME Mexican peso futures hedges.
pegMechanism: KYC-gated mint and redemption through the immutable Ethereum Controller contract using EIP-712 orders signed by approved participants and cosigned by a Tenbin backend HSM minter key in standard (backend-executed) or cosigned (user-executed) modes. Redemptions burn tMXN and settle atomically on-chain in USDC once Tenbin's backend approves and cosigns the order (approval timing is discretionary and unbounded on-chain) at the MXN/USD reference value rather than fiat pesos, subject to a Chainlink MXN/USD 8% backstop tolerance, a 300,000,000 tMXN per-block limit, and pass-through execution costs plus a conditional market adjustment fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 PR-2 addition review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Tenbin primary documentation and binding Terms of Use specify that tMXN is a USDC-collateralized synthetic FX debt-note whose Mexican peso price exposure is hedged off-chain with delta-one CME futures via regulated FCM counterparties and prime broker Ripple Prime, with on-chain USDC held in a Morpho V2 vault. The peg relies on a centrally operated delta-neutral hedging program rather than Mexican peso bank cash or T-bills, matching synthetic-delta-neutral.

notices.title: Synthetic MXN debt-note, aggregate PoR only, and thin DEX liquidity
notices.message: tMXN is an unsecured Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC debt-note backed by USDC and hedged with CME MXN futures, redeemable only in USDC under KYC rather than fiat Mexican pesos. No asset-specific independent reserve attestation is published; Tenbin's Base Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed reports one combined off-chain reserve figure across all Tenbin assets. Public on-chain AMM liquidity is minimal, with near-zero DEX trading volume.
